decisions.reason: Ending the project stops further revisions but does not change or rescind the established peak-alignment rule in the existing artwork; no candidate attribute or scope change is entailed.
The project-ending decision does not alter the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes in the existing artwork.
The source does not change the common-baseline rule or require its removal from the current artwork.
The request to end revisions and deliver editable working files does not modify the previously specified acceptable formats for iteration-review proofs.
